entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ahhh! I love the feelin' of noodles slidin'[n]down my throat! Sweat drippin' over my[n]face!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This shit's the best, man! Ramen is life!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Light soup like this really gets your body[n]goin' again after a good run, y'know.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We used to come all the way out here[n]after practice and...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, I guess that's all in the past...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, I've seen Nakaoka around[n]a few times...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But for some reason it don't look like[n]he's gettin' along with the others.
Nakaoka?
Are you worried about him?[clr 27]
Just leave him be.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A guy from the track team... Er, ex-track[n]team. Remember meetin' him back[n]behind the gym?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah... Kinda.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, you're prolly right... but I dunno.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I've been thinkin' about what he said...[n]How the whole track team was puttin' up[n]with Kamoshida's shit...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And how I effed it all up for 'em...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I think he was right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They don't even got a club room[n]anymore, so they've been storin'[n]all their stuff behind the gym.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They can't use any school gear either,[n]so they just run laps around the block[n]for practice.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...There ain't really a place for outcasts[n]like that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I should know that better than anyone...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's good they're keepin' their heads low[n]now though. I don't want 'em endin' up[n]like me.
But you're doing great.[clr 27]
It's not so bad.
I know how you feel.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Y'know what? You're right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaddya mean?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah... We're both outcasts here, huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's prolly tough just walkin' around[n]school for you with all them rumors[n]an' shit...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Heh, we really don't belong anywhere...[n]but y'know, maybe that ain't so bad[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess now that I'm thinkin' about it,[n]tryin' to fit in is a real pain in the ass.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, I'd never've met you guys[n]if I wasn't an outcast, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, uh... it's all good.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real though, it's been a shit ton[n]of fun! Hangin' out with you guys is[n]so freakin' cool!
I feel like my bond with Ryuji[n]is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I just hope there's something I can do[n]to help those track guys.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Though it'd prolly mess 'em up if I tried[n]to butt in...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, we still gotta find a new spot[n]for our trainin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hm... I'll think about it. No slackin' off[n]'til then, mkay?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Later, dude.
